This Issue is public. Remove secrets, personal or customer data, account or
tenant identifiers, private URLs, unsanitized logs, confidential diagnostics,
and vulnerability details. Use private security reporting or authenticated
support when the information is not safe to publish.

## Product/Component

Choose a customer-facing product or component.

## Affected Version

Use a public release or documentation version.

## Deployment Mode

Choose: EnterpriseAI managed service, customer-managed deployment, local
development or evaluation, or documentation only.

## Customer Impact

Describe observable customer impact without assigning internal or contractual
severity.

## Regression Status

Choose: Yes, No, or Unknown.

## Sanitized Reproduction

Provide the smallest public-safe steps using synthetic data.

## Expected Result

Describe the expected public behavior.

## Actual Result

Describe the observed behavior without logs or confidential diagnostics.

## Public-content confirmation

- [ ] I confirm that I removed credentials, personal data, customer or tenant identifiers, private URLs, unsanitized logs, and vulnerability details.
